recentItems.title: Two Groups Of Strangers Fend For Themselves In An ABANDONED Town | Apocalypse | Channel 4
recentItems.description:
If the world as we know it came to an end, what would you do? 

In a bold social experiment two groups of ordinary people are left to fend for themselves in an abandoned town for 28 days. With no running water, no heating and no electricity, will the group of strangers band together to survive or will it all just descend into absolute chaos?

Stream Apocalypse on Channel 4 from 13th September.
